name: Land Regulatory Intelligence (LRI)
description: Benchmark data and code for a multi-country vision-language model benchmark on regulatory grounding: first-pass screening of spatial discrepancy candidates between physical conditions observed in remote sensing imagery (de facto) and legal designations in public registers (de jure). Covers Paris, New York City and Tokyo (1,174 tiles) under four input modalities. Includes per-tile raw responses of all five evaluated models (Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Opus 4.5, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Pro), the prompt-sensitivity, vector-completeness and rendering-sensitivity runs, tile-level metadata with tile-centre coordinates for all three cities, prompt templates, experiment runners, and a script that recomputes Tables 4-11 and Table S1 of the paper. Image rasters and the tile-generation code are not redistributed.
